correctness.rationale: The exact boundary formula and 91/252/168 cells follow from the 14-vertex 21-edge graph and unordered deleted product; the reconstructed maps satisfy d1*d2=0. Each of 42 actual disjoint-hexagon torus chains lies in ker d2. A specified 14x14 coefficient minor of fourteen such cycles is -1; a separate mod-101 elimination gives rank(d2)>=154, while the fourteen cycles imply rank(d2)<=154, so all top integral homology has rank fourteen and the primitive torus subgroup exhausts it. The exact Smith diagonal of d2 is 153 units and one factor 2; d1 has rank90, giving H1=Z^8+Z/2. All 336 automorphisms act on full signed chains with integral coordinate recovery, and a fixed-cell Lefschetz formula independently agrees with every rational trace. Claims are finite and do not rest on incomplete enumeration.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the unique cubic girth-six cage and a canonical nonplanar incidence graph. The complete set of first-length possible disjoint-cycle product tori is a single natural geometric symmetry orbit. An explicit integral basis from that orbit settles an actual saturation/generation question (rational spanning alone would not suffice). The exact 336-element rational character, including the absence of invariant homology, is an independent symmetry invariant not encoded by Betti numbers and provides a reproducible nonplanar comparison for geometric-generator theory.
